'''Rebel personnel carriers''' or '''Transport speeders''', jokingly called '''chariots''' by the [[Rebel technician|ground crew]] who operated them, were [[repulsorlift]] crafts<ref name="The Ultimate Visual Guide" /> used by the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="The Bad Batch" /> and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as personnel carriers. They notably carried [[starfighter]] [[pilot]]s from their waiting rooms to their waiting ships.<ref name="The Ultimate Visual Guide" /> Open on all sides, those [[speeder]]s were able to seat two rows of personnel back to back, and required one operator.<ref name="ANH" />
